hardness_rationale: Eight stages are load-bearing on each other and every cheap path through them succeeds silently. The primary agent-side gates are the three decisions in Stage 2, in ascending order of nastiness. The triage is genuinely contestable rather than a glance: ref_01 and ref_02 are both flat captures of the same printed lockup, neutrally named, same file type, and the tempting one — shot in raking light on textured letterpress stock — looks crisper and higher in contrast on a preview while its ink is abraded across two stroke groups and its paper tooth reads as ink to any selection, so tracing it succeeds and returns a mark with broken strokes and speckle that only fails at poster scale and on the ink ground; the correct capture is the flatter, duller, complete one, and the abraded capture still has a legitimate job as a photographic detail. Above the triage sit the two gates that actually generate plausible-looking wrong answers: the selection prompt must name the graphic's own colour, medium and line quality rather than its substrate, or the mask lands on the card and every downstream step returns a rectangle that reports success; and polarity must be set before tracing or the positive comes back inverted. Below them sit three hygiene decisions no tool performs and none of which raise anything — the full-canvas opaque backing path must be removed, a coordinate system must be injected, and a reduced-path derivative must be authored for every small placement, because the raw trace is dozens of ungrouped paths that turn to mush at the 300×250 the media buy exists for. The human-hard elements are cross-asset consistency to a checkable target and constraint-reasoning around a documented tool boundary. Consistency is graded twice: once on the archive masters, where three frames shot at three times of day must land within ΔE00 ≤4 on white point, ≤3 levels on black point and ≤300 K on temperature, with a ≤3-level channel spread on the in-shot neutral region, reached by divergent per-frame parameters the agent reports rather than measures; and again on the route grade, where the agent must declare a non-neutral authored look consistent with the direction it just recommended and hold all three frames to that new target — a stage deliberately sequenced after the route decision so the grade can express an art direction rather than merely correct an error. Auto-tone and a single global correction both succeed and both fail only on the one canvas permitted to carry three frames. The constraint-reasoning chain is real and undocumented in the brief: no photograph can be placed by address in an authored document (every attempt returns an unannounced empty box, including addresses the connector itself produced), which forces images into the document body, which forces per-placement resolution and quality budgeting, which determines the payload, which determines the handover route — and the agent is graded on reporting that chain, not on guessing a threshold nobody has tested. Two further decision traps carry delayed, visible consequences: cutting the portrait and vertical formats from the finished hero rather than from the graded master takes a free enlargement disclosed only in an easily-skipped field, and the tooling actively offers a canvas-extension chain as the tidy fix for a vertical that will not fill, which violates the client's true-representation rule on a house genuinely for sale. The print stage is front-loaded behind the earliest client deadline precisely so it is not the thing a budget-exhausted run drops, and it plants the strongest silent gate available here: the field summary for the converted card drops a text run while keeping its line break, so the string reads as well formed, every later offset is wrong by a fixed amount, the validator passes, the placeholder step reports success, and two of six fields are absent from all ten printed cards — correctable only by inspecting the document's real story contents. The price band is what makes composition gradeable rather than a matter of taste: at €4.6M–€5.2M with an 18-month cycle the answer is no price, no rate, no CTA, one photograph per canvas, text and mark held outside 8% of the short edge, small type, a small crest and statutory small print set as typography; the same six pieces at €200 a night invert every one of those. Critically, those rules govern the delivered suite and not the exploration, so the three A3 route comps are free to move margin, crest scale, treatment and hierarchy — the recommendation then has to argue the chosen route back against the rules, which turns the constraint set into the thing the argument is made against rather than the thing that flattens the options. The brief carries no diagnosis anywhere: it does not say which frame is cold, which is blown, which is not level, that anything sits behind the mark, or which capture can be traced — only the client's symptom ('three different houses in three different countries') and her acceptance bar. Acceptance is measurable throughout without the agent ever reading a pixel: the tolerances above on the archive and graded masters, foreign objects absent from every published canvas, exact output dimensions with no enlargement factor above 1.0 and no format derived from a sibling crop, no full-canvas path and no filled counters over the ink colour, stroke continuity against the clean source, reduced-path mark below 90 px, resolved typeface and numeric weight matching the Stage 3 declaration across five documents, exact per-root canvas sizes including two mm-derived ones, table cells diffed against the CSV, ad-unit legibility floors at 1:1, headline identical across three documents, page-count equal to row-count with all six fields on all ten pages, and filename-to-content identity on every per-guest card.
why_not_a_vlm_one_shot: A vision model can describe every one of these deliverables and produce none of them. It cannot recover the crest, because recovery is an operation on pixels — deciding between two look-alike captures on stroke integrity, isolating ink from substrate, inverting polarity, tracing to editable geometry, then repairing what the trace does not do — and the whole point is that the client has no source file and needs the mark back as artwork that scales, not a picture of a mark and not a plausible redraw, which would be a different logo and would fail the client's own governance page. It cannot converge three differently-lit frames on a neutral target and then hold them to a second, authored, non-neutral target while leaving the archive masters gradeable; a describe-then-regenerate model would invent three new images of a house that does not exist, which is exactly what the compliance rule forbids for a property on the market at €4.6M. It cannot deliver a native editable document: the poster, the comps, the social set, the particulars and the ad units are handed over as documents the client's own team opens and edits — she says so, she edits the particulars between viewings and re-times the posts herself — with live text in a licensed typeface, a real table bound to the CSV and the crest present as editable geometry. A flat rendering of any of those is not the deliverable; it is a screenshot of one, and it cannot be changed without coming back to the freelancer. It cannot license a photograph, and it cannot honestly assert provenance or that a frame is not machine-generated. It cannot rebuild a flat PDF into an InDesign template with live fields, deliver that template to a vendor who accepts nothing else, and run a roster through it so ten guests each receive a correctly populated, correctly named card — a document-structure problem, not an image problem, and one whose central failure is invisible in every success message. And the difficulty is not in any single operation anyway; it is in the dependency graph. One wrong capture in Stage 2 is wrong in eleven later placements. One convergence shortcut in Stage 1 is invisible until Stage 7 puts three frames on one page. One format cut from a sibling crop silently interpolates. One field offset trusted rather than verified empties two fields on all ten printed cards. One route recommended and not executed makes six artefacts inconsistent with the argument attached to them. Those are failures a model can only avoid by doing the work in order, looking at what came back, and correcting — the behaviour the benchmark exists to measure, and the thing a single-shot description cannot exhibit.
connector_doability_note: ENVIRONMENT PRECONDITION, stated explicitly because the task is not connector-only: the agent has a local shell (curl, base64, unzip) alongside the connector. Local work is required to download and repair the traced SVG, base64-encode budgeted photographs, unzip the IDML and concatenate story runs, and name ten downloaded per-guest files. Connector-only execution is out of scope for this task. Account verified as "auth", so Express export is permitted and the full Adobe Fonts library is available. Stage 1: asset_initialize_file_upload → curl PUT → asset_finalize_file_upload is the verified headless input path (the file picker is not required); image_auto_straighten is the only rectifier and exposes no angle parameter, so the horizon gate is written as an operation-order requirement plus a loose residual tolerance plus a disclosure duty, never as a tight angle the agent has no lever to hit; image_apply_adjustments carries exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, temperature and tint per frame; asset_inline_preview lets the agent look before and after. Stage 2: image_select_by_prompt reaches ink level on a printed graphic with counters correctly excluded (verified); image_invert_selection sets polarity; image_crop_to_bounds tightens off the returned bbox; image_vectorize traces (verified to yield a correct positive outline from an inverted mask, and verified to always emit a full-canvas background path and no viewBox — both repairs are local file work); image_fill_area supplies the colour-plate route and the flat stone-ground raster. The transparent raster cutout has been REMOVED from the deliverables: image_remove_background is the only alpha-producing tool and is verified to fail on exactly this shape twice over (a solid opaque disc from a ring, and most lettering lost from a disjoint mark), so the derived treatments are SVG colourways plus a declared non-transparent stone-ground PNG. Compound-mark selection is verified unreliable, so ref_01 is pinned in the input-generation spec as the complete lockup printed in ONE ink on a plain pale card, evenly lit, which is the verified-working case; the sanctioned grader-side fallback if a single ink-level prompt returns a partial mask is select → invert → image_fill_area(white) on the ORIGINAL → crop → vectorize, which is verified to return the complete lockup. Both routes must be run against the actual generated ref_01 before the task ships. ref_02 is generated as the same lockup on textured stock in raking light with abraded ink; it must be verified pre-ship that (a) it traces successfully, and (b) the trace visibly carries broken strokes and paper speckle at 4×, so the triage has a real consequence. INPUT-GENERATION CONSTRAINTS the harness must honour: the in-shot neutral reference region sits within the outer 12% of one edge of each capture, positioned so that all six listing crops (2400×1350, three 1600×2000, one 1080×1920), the poster crop, the three social crops and the particulars placements can each exclude it while still framing their subject — validated against all of those crops before the task ships, because no tool removes an object and framing is the only mechanism. Captures are declared at ~4800 px long edge (camera scale) so every listed output is reachable by pure downscale. Stage 3: font_recommend per role, font_styles for the real numeric weights, find_fonts to launder every name into canonical PostScript form, get_fontkit_embed_url for one non-domain-locked kit — all verified live, and the kit link is the one external stylesheet the readiness skill permits. suggest_type_palettes / get_type_palette are not surfaced and are not designed against; the similarity fallback is known broken and is planted as a trap, not required. Stages 5 and 7: create_visual_design_express_skill → author self-contained HTML → html_export_readiness_skill → export_html_to_express. Both skills are deferred-loaded via ToolSearch, and the readiness skill runs before EVERY export and EVERY retry — this is stated in both stages' subtasks. export_html_to_express is verified to produce native editable documents, verified for multi-root exports with per-root canvas sizes in one call, verified for true mm canvases at exactly 96 dpi (297×420 mm → 1123×1587 px; 210×297 mm → 794×1123 px), and verified for real tables, inline-SVG vector, gradients, radii, rotation and rich inline runs. Canvas sizes are declared per root via data-canvas-* with hz:slide-selector naming the per-item class; canvasWidth / canvasHeight / slideSelector are never passed as tool params. The 16:9 deck was deliberately replaced with five A4 portrait roots, which is both the correct artefact for prime residential particulars and a smaller payload. PAYLOAD BUDGET, pinned rather than assumed: every embedded photograph is downscaled to its rendered size, capped at 1400 px on the long edge, JPEG quality ≤72, and inlined as an data: URI (no URL is ever left in the HTML — verified that every external address, including the connector's own outputs and documented-allowlisted hosts, is silently replaced with a placeholder). One photograph per root except the particulars honest-view page. The crest is embedded once per document as a / symbol IF that survives the importer, otherwise as the reduced-path single-colour version repeated. THREE PRE-SHIP HARNESS VERIFICATIONS ARE REQUIRED and the spec is designed to survive any outcome: (1) whether / survives the importer; (2) whether an inline `html` payload above 70 KB actually imports, since the only recorded finding is a policy instruction to warn the user, not an observed failure; (3) whether the url route — upload the HTML via asset_initialize/finalize_file_upload with media_type text/html and pass the returned *.adobe.com presignedAssetUrl as `url` — actually imports, which the audit never executed, and whose adjacent data point (the importer not fetching at.adobe.com for images) is negative. Fallback if the url route fails: asset_get_presigned_urls on the stored asset for an ACP download URL; final fallback: the budget above keeps every document inline-viable, which is why the budget is tight. Accordingly the inline-vs-url decision is graded as a REPORTING gate (VA-25) rather than as a fail against an untested threshold. Verification is headless: asset_search(entityScope "CCAsset") → asset_get_presigned_urls → asset_inline_preview returns root 1 for the model to look at. The multi-root limitation is designed in honestly — Stage 5 and Stage 7 both require the agent to confirm root 1 visually, verify the remaining roots from the returned HzHTML, and state which was which. Stage 5's context image uses asset_search(entityScope "StockAsset") with SHORT queries and NO orientation filter (both parameter behaviours verified), then asset_license_and_download_stock for genuine full resolution and a clean isGenTech flag. The licensed file is curl'd locally and RE-UPLOADED through asset_initialize/finalize_file_upload before any image_* processing, because the image tools enforce their own stricter domain whitelist and a presigned S3 Stock URL is untested against it. boards_create_new_board + boards_add_items_to_board persist the shortlist headlessly (12 placements per call, HTTP 201 means partial success — re-send only failedItems); create_firefly_board is not used because it persists nothing. Stage 6 uses image_crop_and_resize and image_crop_to_bounds only in the downscale direction from 4800 px masters, so 2400×1350, 1600×2000 and 1080×1920 are all reachable without enlargement. Chained downscales (crop_to_bounds then crop_and_resize) are explicitly PERMITTED by VA-04, because a portrait or vertical crop from a landscape master spans the full source height and the crop tool's align parameter has no effect on an axis that spans the full source dimension — so a two-step chain is sometimes the only way to place the frame. What VA-04 forbids is any enlargement factor above 1.0, any 'upscaled' trade-off entry, and deriving a format from the finished hero. image_generative_expand is deliberately never used, because the true-representation rule makes it wrong on property imagery, and the tooling's offered requires_expand_chain trade-off is planted as a trap. Stage 4 is the verified InDesign chain: convert_pdf_to_indd → export_idml for real structure inspection → generate_indd_mapping_prompt (offsets recomputed from the unzipped IDML story runs, never from the lossy textContent) → prepare_indd_merge_template → export_idml again to confirm the fields landed → document_merge_data_layout to application/pdf for the ten-page press file (page-count = row-count verified) and either document_render_layout(createSeparateFiles:true) or a recordRange loop for the ten identity-guaranteed per-guest files (the multi-record raster route is known to return records in an order contradicting its labels and is planted as a trap). TWO PRE-SHIP VERIFICATIONS ARE REQUIRED HERE TOO: viewing_card.pdf must be generated via headless Chrome (the verified-converting route — thin or synthetic PDFs fail opaquely), and it must be confirmed that generate_indd_mapping_prompt's reported textContent actually drops a run against the concatenated IDML runs, with the confirmed offset delta recorded in the grader-side notes. The card carries SIX fields — guest name, the line beneath it, viewing date, slot time, broker name, broker direct line — and viewings.csv carries six matching columns for ten rows; the card copy is authored as a single continuous story so a dropped run shifts every later offset. If the drop cannot be reproduced, the card copy is adjusted until it is; the spec does not ship with its strongest gate assumed. The crest is NOT re-placed into the card through the connector — the client says the card design stays as it is, free-form placement into a PDF-derived document is not available, and element_reuse is worded as a visual reconciliation rather than a placement. BUDGET AND PARTIAL CREDIT: the engagement is large by design. font_recommend returns ~15K tokens per call and generate_indd_mapping_prompt re-emits ~3,400 tokens of boilerplate per call, and every visual check costs an inline image. Front-loading the print stage behind the client's earliest deadline (cards to the vendor on the 22nd, poster on the 26th, particulars and imagery on the 1st) means a truncated run loses polish rather than losing the one stage nothing outside this connector reproduces. Scoring is explicitly per-deliverable partial credit; a run that ends after Stage 7 is scored as truncated, never as a completed suite. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED as unusable or unavailable on this host: fill_text (non-deterministic, truncates, leaks label prefixes), animate_design (returns prose only), replace_image, download_design, suggest_type_palettes, get_type_palette (none surfaced), qr_mappings (accepted but inert), every video and audio tool and both vector-merge tools (async with no poll tool here), pdfPreset and useDocumentBleeds gates (a PDF-derived template carries no bleed and the preset enum is undiscoverable — the agent is asked to REPORT this, not satisfy it), and any flat file export out of a finished Express document, which is why the handover sheet is itself a graded deliverable. Nothing in the kit requires reading a pixel, a hex or a channel level: the agent works by eye and reports the parameters it set; every numeric tolerance is evaluated grader-side on the output. Harness note: only client_brief is agent-facing — stages, traps, failure_gates, hardness_rationale and this note are the grader-side reference solution and must not be shown to the agent under test, since they name the triage answer.
